naturalisation.absenceCountingQuote: You must only count whole days' absences from the UK. You must not count the dates of departure and arrival as absences.
naturalisation.qualifyingStart: day after the application date minus the qualifying period (exemple officiel : demande du 1 September 2022 → présence exigée le 2 September 2017)

fees.staleOfficialPage: La page « Permanent resident » de Home Affairs affiche encore AUD285 (18-59 ans) alors que le formulaire 1298i de juillet 2026 donne $595 : le site suit le 1298i et le signale.

processing.prPageFigures: Page Permanent resident : 75 % en 13 mois, 90 % en 16 mois (dépôt à cérémonie), plus ancien que la page des délais

n400._absences: Policy Manual 12 D.3: absence of more than 6 months (more than 180 days) but less than 1 year (less than 365 days) = rebuttable presumption of a break; 1 year or more = break. Departure and return days are not days of absence (12 D.4).

processing._note: National median N-400 processing time (months): time to complete half of the cases in the fiscal year. USCIS fact sheet 'Historical Processing Times Trends FY 2016-2024', data as of 2024-03-05; FY 2024 = 1 Oct 2023 to 31 Jan 2024. Office-level times are only in the USCIS processing times tool (egov.uscis.gov), which blocks automated reading: the user types the figure shown there.
